meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证程序缺陷并修复,自动以 PR 或 issue 形式提交到正确仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你修好了某个工具的 Bug,却不确定该提 PR 还是开 issue。
copy.tagline_en: Verify and fix a defect, then submit it as the right pull request or issue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you fixed a bug but aren't sure whether to open a PR or an issue.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调试 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的具体缺陷,在临时工作区写最小修复并验证。上游 openai/codex 的 bug 产出 fork PR;LazyCodex 自身的缺陷产出内嵌补丁的已验证修复 issue(不开 PR)。
howto.when: 当你要求修复 bug、提交 bug 修复、为 bug 开 PR,或调试并提交 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修 LazyCodex 安装器这个 bug,提交验证过的修复。
say.note: 会开一个内嵌补丁的已验证修复 issue,不开 PR

say.text: 先复现这个缺陷,再给出最小修复,附上前后日志。
say.note: 会保存复现与验证日志

howto.what_en: Claude debugs a concrete LazyCodex or Codex defect, writes the smallest fix in a temp workspace, and verifies it. Upstream openai/codex bugs get a fork PR; LazyCodex-owned defects get a verified-fix issue with the patch embedded.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex installer bug and file a verified fix.
say_en.note: Opens a verified-fix issue, never a PR

say_en.text: This bug reproduces on openai/codex too - open a fork PR.
say_en.note: Forks, pushes a branch, opens the PR

say_en.text: Reproduce the defect first, then give the smallest fix with logs.
